description: Unit tests for the Windows DHCP PAC file fetcher in Chromium, including tests for adapter name retrieval, fetch operations, cancellation, timeouts, and reusability.

classes.name: RealFetchTester
classes.description: Helper class to test real fetch operations, including cancellation and deferred cancellation.

classes.name: DelayingDhcpPacFileAdapterFetcher
classes.description: Custom fetcher that delays DHCP queries to simulate longer network delays.

classes.name: DelayingDhcpPacFileFetcherWin
classes.description: Custom fetcher that creates delayed adapter fetchers for testing deferred cancellation.

classes.name: DummyDhcpPacFileAdapterFetcher
classes.description: Mock fetcher that simulates fetching a PAC script with configurable delay and result.

classes.name: MockDhcpPacFileFetcherWin
classes.description: Mock implementation of DhcpPacFileFetcherWin for testing, with controllable adapter fetchers and adapter names.

classes.name: FetcherClient
classes.description: Helper class to run fetch tests, handle callbacks, and manage test state.

methods.name: RunTest
methods.description: Initiates a fetch operation and handles completion.

methods.name: RunTestWithCancel
methods.description: Runs a fetch operation and cancels it immediately.

methods.name: RunTestWithDeferredCancel
methods.description: Runs a fetch operation with a delayed cancel to test deferred cancellation.

methods.name: FinishTestAllowCleanup
methods.description: Allows worker threads to finish, with a sleep delay.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the dummy fetcher with specific result, delay, and script.
